{{Quote|Don't worry sir, your cargo will be completely secure at Martle Station.|Governor Varla Prule|<ref name="PH" />}}
'''Martle Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Remduba II]], on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. It was an aging [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] platform that served as a cargo transfer and [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] point. Martle Station was overseen by [[Varla Prule]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Remduba system]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Martle Station served as a [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] of call for the secret Imperial [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] known as the [[Perlemian Haul]]. When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] learned that the convoy would be stopping at Martle Station, an elite Rebel strike force was [[Hijacking of Freighter M226|dispatched]] to the platform to infiltrate and hijack [[Freighter M226|one]] of the Perlemian Haul's [[Temple-class heavy freighter|freighters]].

Boarding the station under the cover identity of [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], the team made contact with the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Passk]]. The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Passk's Oddities|shop-keeper]] assisted the Rebels with gathering information on the impending arrival of the Perlemian Haul at Martle Station. Eventually, the strike force members gained employment with the station's [[workgang]]s of [[Hangar/Legends|dockworkers]] and shiphands and, when the convoy arrived in the Remduba [[Star system/Legends|system]] and began loading and unloading cargo, infiltrated the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] targeted by the Alliance.

==Description==
Martle Station was an [[Space station/Legends|orbital platform]] located above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Remduba II]]. It was a part of the [[Remduba system]], which lay on the<ref name="PH" /> [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].<ref name="PH" />

The main section of the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] station was shaped like a truncated cone, with four hemispherical components located at its top and two narrow components extending from the bottom. At the main section's sides were attached two smaller sections, visually similar to the main one minus the four hemispheres. One of the smaller sections was linked to an additional flattened section. Martle Station was silver-gray in [[Color/Legends|color]] and had red markings and running lights along its surface, as well as numerous antennas extending from both its top and bottom.<ref name="PH" />

==History==
{{RPG|"[[Perlemian Haul (adventure)|Perlemian Haul]]"}}
===Mission to the Perlemian Haul===
{{Quote|Shuttle 201-7, we have you on our scopes. Please relay your business in Martle Station space and transmit your identification.|Martle Station control|<ref name="PH" />}}
[[File:Remduba_system_convoy_AoRCR.png|thumb|left|200px|Martle Station served as a port of call for the Perlemian Haul convoy.]]
At one point, [[Varla Prule]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the Remduba [[Star system/Legends|system]], assured a individual that the individual's cargo would be safe at Martle Station. Considered to be relatively old by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the station served as the preeminent [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] of call for the secret Imperial [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] colloquially known as the [[Perlemian Haul]].<ref name="PH" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Yavin">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]], which includes the [[roleplaying game]] adventure "[[Perlemian Haul (adventure)|Perlemian Haul]]," is set at some point following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] received intelligence confirming the existence of the convoy and that it would be stopping at Martle Station for cargo transfer and [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]]. Intent on capturing the valuable cargo [[Transport/Legends|transported]] by the Perlemian Haul, the Alliance [[Hijacking of Freighter M226|sent]] an elite strike force of Rebel [[operative]]s to the space station in order to infiltrate and hijack [[Freighter M226|one]] of the Perlemian Haul's [[Temple-class heavy freighter|freighters]].<ref name="PH" />

Arriving in the Remduba system in a [[Shuttle 201-7|stolen shuttle]], the team was hailed by Martle Station control, which demanded that the operatives, posing as [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] at the time, state the purpose of their visit to the station as well as transmit their identification. After complying with station control's demands&mdash;and using the false identification provided by the Alliance&mdash;the team boarded the orbital platform. The operatives then made their way through the station's facilities, eventually locating the [[Passk's Oddities|curiosities shop]] of their contact, the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Passk]].<ref name="PH" />

===Gathering information===
[[File:ImperialNavyTroopers-AoRCR.png|thumb|right|230px|A pair of Rebel operatives posed as Imperial Navy troopers (pictured) of Martle Station.]]
The Rebel agents informed Passk of the impending arrival of the Perlemian Haul, at which point the shop-owner agreed to assist the team with gaining more information for its upcoming mission. The information broker provided the Rebels with a pair of [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy trooper]] [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniforms]] that allowed them to infiltrate [[Martle Station's command and control center]]. There, the agents accessed a [[computer terminal]] in order to gain information regarding incoming shipments and convoys.<ref name="PH" />

Next, Passk personally introduced the Rebels to Governor Prule. At first, the governor attempted to negotiate a bribe in exchange for providing the team with information. However, in the end, the agents used incriminating evidence on Prule gained from Passk to blackmail the governor. As a result, they gained access to relatively ordinary Martle Station reports, such as docking schedules and work rosters, which nevertheless provided additional information on the Perlemian Haul's schedule upon its arrival at the station.<ref name="PH" />

In addition to Prule, Passk introduced the Rebel strike force to [[Raf]], the leader of the [[Big Black]] [[workgang]] of Martle Station's cargo bay workers. Passk's contacts among the station's working class provided the Rebels with additional transport schedules of the station. Eventually, in order to gain access to the [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] of the Perlemian Haul, the agents applied for and gained employment with the orbital platform's shiphands and dockworkers, where they survived the rigors of work aboard Martle Station while waiting for the convoy to arrive in the Remduba system.<ref name="PH" />

===Infiltrating the freighter===
When the Perlemian Haul finally arrived, Martle Station became the site of high levels of activity. Almost every workgang aboard the platform was assigned a [[Hangar/Legends|cargo docking bay]]. [[Cargo container/Legends|Orbital containers]] containing large quantities of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on and transported up from Remduba II were at once loaded on the station's [[Cargo tug/Legends|cargo tugs]] and ferried out to the convoy, while the Perlemian Haul's [[Starship/Legends|freighters]] were unloaded in return&mdash;all done by workgangs sent out both to deliver and retrieve cargo.<ref name="PH" />

[[File:TempleClass-AoRCR.png|thumb|left|230px|The Rebel strike force infiltrated Freighter M226, a ''Temple''-class heavy freighter (pictured), at Martle Station.]]
A security screen was provided both by Martle Station's and the convoy's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], and the orbital platform's security [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] maintained a more highly visible presence while overseeing the proceedings. However, under the cover of the heavy activity, the Rebel strike force was able to infiltrate the rear loading bay of its target freighter, where the vessel's [[Imperial Navy crewman|crew]] assisted the Martle Station dockworkers with unloading cargo. The Rebels then began to make their way to the forward-located command module of the 400-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long vessel, and the Perlemian Haul eventually left Martle Station and the Remduba system.<ref name="PH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
[[File:Passk-AoRCR.png|thumb|right|200px|The information broker Passk was personally acquainted with both the working class of Martle Station and Governor Varla Prule.]]
Martle Station was home to nearly 2,000 citizens, of which the majority were working-class people employed as dockworkers, shiphands, and station support staff, as well as civilian businesspeople and employees working to keep the former [[Foodstuff/Legends|fed]] and entertained. The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] shop-owner and information broker Passk belonged to the latter segment of the population and had extensive knowledge on the underground economy of Martle Station, having many contacts and associates among the station's workgangs of dockhands, including Raf, the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] leader of the Big Black workgang.<ref name="PH" />

Passk also had extensive dealings with the being in charge of Martle Station, Imperial Governor Varla Prule of the Remduba system. The governor was highly corrupt, and the pair made several illicit transactions, records of which&mdash;along with incriminating physical evidence&mdash;Passk held as a type of insurance while dealing with Prule. The Galactic Empire also had a [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] presence aboard Martle Station in the form of a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] and a small [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] troopers.<ref name="PH" />

The officials of Martle Station were bored and corrupt, and the traffic control staff of station control was lazy. Whenever a vessel approached the station and was detected on its [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], the latter would request identification be transmitted, only to perform lax scrutiny on the provided credentials. As a result of the corruption of the station's authorities, docking fees were inflated.<ref name="PH" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|Welcome to Passk's Oddities, my friends. What can Passk do for you on this fine day?|Passk, to members of a Rebel strike force|<ref name="PH" />}}
The layout of Martle Station was spread across multiple decks. While access to some of them&mdash;such as those used by Governor Prule, the station's Imperial garrison, and other Imperial concerns, as well as the deck serving as the station's command and control center&mdash;was restricted, the majority of the orbital platform was open to visitors. The area of Martle Station considered its [[City/Legends|urban]] center contained the curiosities shop known as Passk's Oddities.<ref name="PH" />

Martle Station's command and control center contained [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminals that could be used to access the [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] of the center's computer systems. The station, including its control and command deck, had light security, including mechanical [[Lock/Legends|locks]], [[Camera/Legends|cameras]], and occasional patrols by Imperial Navy troopers. In addition, Martle Station was equipped with several cargo docking bays, which were used by the station's dockworkers to load and unload any visiting starships.<ref name="PH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Martle Station appeared in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] adventure "[[Perlemian Haul (adventure)|Perlemian Haul]]." It was included in the [[2014]] [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]]. The adventure provides the player characters with several alternate methods of gathering information while aboard Martle Station. In addition, it is suggested that, upon the Perlemian Haul's arrival at Martle Station, the characters can either stow aboard their target freighter on one of Martle Station's cargo [[Spacetug/Legends|tugs]] or [[cargo canister]]s, or be sent to the freighter to handle cargo as part of one of the station's workgangs. This article assumes as many of those scenarios as possible play out as described without contradicting each other.<ref name="PH" />
